{{Youmay|the cultural tradition|[[Way of the Wookiee!|the comic story]] of the same name}}
{{Quote|He still looks ''hacked'' at being in your debt, but he's got to abide by the ''way'' of the Wookiee&mdash;which is that saving the ''life'' of a foe wipes out the original ''grounds'' for the feud. Whether that fiery-tempered furball appreciates it or not your two families will be at ''peace''.|Han Solo, to Chewbacca, on Hronk|<ref name="Way of the Wookiee!">{{StoryCite|story=Way of the Wookiee!|book=Star Wars Weekly 94}}</ref>}}
The '''way of the Wookiee''' was a set of customs and traditions that the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] people adhered to. Among the things that the way of the Wookiee regulated was the blood feud between Wookiee clans and the methods of its resolution.
